bucketList.text: Sing our hearts out on a late-night drive 🚗🎶
Chase the Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) together in Norway 🌌
Cook a gourmet 3-course dinner together without setting off the smoke alarm 🍝
Adopt a golden retriever puppy and spoil it rotten 🐶
Go stargazing in a glass igloo surrounded by snow ❄️
Get matching silly pajamas for Christmas morning 🎄
Build our cozy dream home with a sunny reading corner 🏡

promises.content: "I promise to always make you chai when you're stressed, hold your hand in crowded rooms, and never stop reminding you how gorgeous you are."
"I promise that no matter how many years go by, I will always look at you with the exact same butterflies as the first day I fell for you."
"I promise to listen even when you don't say a word, and to be your safest place to land every single day."
I promise to dance with you in the kitchen at midnight
